title: What unit the products on the Logs and Fair Use pages are licensed by, and how it is counted

prose.text: {{zia-types}} {{zia-traffic}} {{zia-site-workload}} {{zia-addons}} The fair-use thresholds are in [[shared.logs-fair-use.fair-use-limits]] and the hub is [[shared.logs-fair-use]].

prose.label: Entity and asset products.
prose.text: {{secops}} {{aem}} {{uvm}} {{idp}} {{netobs}} Some pages repeat wording from a different license unit {{gap:copied-unit-wording}}.

checks.do: The license unit the product's own page states: ZIA and ZPA seats counted as unique users over the previous rolling 90-day period, ZSDK monthly active users, DSPM data stores, ZPC workloads.

zia-types.statement: ZIA is licensed by Seat (unique ZIA users over the previous rolling 90-day period; total endpoints across all seats may not exceed three times the seats purchased), Site, ZIA Monthly Traffic, Workload or Data Center.

quotes: The number of seats required for ZIA is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of ZIA over the previous rolling 90-day period.
The total endpoints across all seats may not exceed three times the number of seats purchased.
Site: A subscription license for a site or location
ZIA Monthly Traffic: The total amount of Authenticated Traffic and Unauthenticated Traffic
Data Center: For subscriptions licensed per data center
Workload: For subscriptions licensed per workload (instead of per GB of Monthly Traffic)

zia-traffic.statement: ZIA Monthly Traffic is the Authenticated plus Unauthenticated Traffic uploaded and downloaded via ZIA in a calendar month, measured in GB; Authenticated Traffic is traffic of a known seat, Unauthenticated Traffic is traffic not related to a known seat, including inline guest Wi-Fi, device, server and workload traffic.

quotes: ZIA Monthly Traffic: The total amount of Authenticated Traffic and Unauthenticated Traffic that is uploaded and downloaded via ZIA in a calendar month, measured in GB.
Authenticated Traffic means traffic sent and received by a known seat.
Unauthenticated Traffic means traffic not related to a known seat, including inline guest Wi-Fi, device, server, and workload traffic.

zia-site-workload.statement: For ZIA Site licenses, an IoT site counts only the parent location, and in an IoT hub-and-spoke deployment each spoke or branch behind the hub counts as a site; a Workload is a unique domain name, an IP address or a set of IP addresses; a Data Center license's IP address pair cannot be moved to another data center during the subscription.

quotes: For an IoT site, only the parent location is counted.
In the case of an IoT hub-and-spoke deployment, the spokes or branches behind the hub are each counted as a site.
a workload is defined as a unique domain name, an IP address, or a set of IP addresses.
The same pair of IP addresses cannot be transferred to a different data center during the lifetime of the subscription.

zia-addons.statement: In the ZIA licensing page, Zero Trust Browser (Isolation or Cloud Browser Isolation) and Source IP Anchoring (SIPA) are subscribed per seat with a maximum aggregate amount of ZIA Monthly Traffic across all seats.

quotes: Zero Trust Browser (Isolation or Cloud Browser Isolation) and Source IP Anchoring (SIPA) are subscribed per seat with a maximum aggregate amount of ZIA Monthly Traffic across all seats.

zpa-types.statement: ZPA is licensed by Seat (unique ZPA users over the previous rolling 90-day period), Site (enables Zero Trust SD-WAN), ZPA Monthly Traffic (GB per calendar month), System (each RDP, SSH, VNC or RealVNC target enabling PRA), Workload, and Asset (for Autonomous App Shield).

quotes: The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of ZPA over the previous rolling 90-day period.
Site: A subscription license for a site or location that enables Zero Trust SD-WAN.
The total amount of traffic that is uploaded and downloaded via ZPA in a calendar month, measured in GB.
Each system is equivalent to an RDP, SSH, VNC or RealVNC target that enables Privileged Remote Access (PRA).
Asset: A subscription license for an individual asset used with Autonomous App Shield.
Workload: For subscriptions licensed per workload (instead of per GB of monthly traffic)

zpa-asset.statement: For ZPA Autonomous App Shield, an asset is a host, application or domain in ZPA, and each asset includes an allocation of Shield Tokens and scans; additional tokens may be purchased separately.

quotes: An asset is defined as a host, application, or domain in ZPA.
Each asset includes an allocation of Shield Tokens (tokens) and scans. Additional tokens may be purchased separately.
Asset: A subscription license for an individual asset used with Autonomous App Shield.

zpa-addons.statement: In the ZPA licensing page, Zero Trust Browser and Source IP Anchoring (SIPA) are subscribed per seat with a maximum aggregate amount of ZPA Monthly Traffic across all seats, and ZPA B2B Federation is subscribed per seat.

quotes: Zero Trust Browser (i.e., Browser Isolation, formerly Isolation) and Source IP Anchoring (SIPA) are subscribed per seat with a maximum aggregate amount of ZPA Monthly Traffic across all seats.
ZPA B2B Federation is subscribed per seat.

zdx.statement: ZDX is licensed by seats, counted as unique ZDX users over the previous rolling 90-day period; it should be deployed for the licensed number using selective entitlement and need not cover all Client Connector users.

quotes: The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of ZDX over the previous rolling 90-day period.
You do not have to deploy ZDX for all available Zscaler Client Connector users.
You should deploy ZDX for the number of licenses ordered using selective entitlement.

dspm.statement: DSPM is licensed by data stores: each unique VM counts as one data store, plus storage buckets, databases and any additional supported service configured as a scanned service over the subscription period; deploy using selective account onboarding.

quotes: The number of data stores required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual VMs (every instance is counted as one data store), storage buckets, databases, and any additional supported service that was configured as a scanned service by the customer over the subscription period.
You should deploy DSPM for the number of licenses ordered using selective account onboarding.

zpc.statement: ZPC is licensed by workloads: each VM counts as one workload, every 5 serverless functions count as one workload and every 5 containers count as one workload, over the subscription period.

quotes: every VM is counted as one workload
every 5 serverless functions count as one workload
and containers (every 5 containers count as one workload) over the subscription period.

branch-connector.statement: Zero Trust Branch Connector is licensed by sites/locations protected and data usage; protected devices are unique IP addresses of the endpoint types, counted hourly and averaged over a month, and Guest Wi-Fi SKU endpoints and GB are excluded.

quotes: licensed by the number of sites/locations being protected and the data usage of the protected devices/services
These unique IP addresses are counted at an hourly interval. The total count is calculated by averaging the hourly count over a month.
All endpoints and data transfers (in GB) accounted for in Guest Wi-Fi SKUs are excluded.
The number of protected devices is determined by counting the unique IP addresses for each of the protected endpoint types

ztbrowser.statement: Zero Trust Browser (Cloud Browser, Browser Extension, Enterprise Browser) is licensed by seats, counted as unique users over a rolling 90-day period, and Cloud Browser usage is also subject to the data limits in the SKU.

quotes: The number of seats required is determined by calculating the total number of unique individual users of the Zero Trust Browser service over a rolling 90-day period.
Your usage of the Zero Trust Cloud Browser service is also subject to the data consumption limits stated in your Zero Trust Browser SKU.
Zero Trust Browser (including Zero Trust Cloud Browser, Zero Trust Browser Extension, and Zero Trust Enterprise Browser)

breach-predictor.statement: Breach Predictor is licensed by seats counted as unique Breach Predictor users over the previous rolling 90-day period.

quotes: The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of Breach Predictor over the previous rolling 90-day period.

business-insights.statement: Business Insights is licensed by seats, being users for which it tracks SaaS license usage, counted as unique users over the previous rolling 90-day period.

quotes: A seat is a subscription license for the Business Insights service for an individual authorized user for which Business Insights is tracking SaaS license usage.
The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of Business Insights over the previous rolling 90-day period.

deception.statement: Deception is licensed by seats counted as unique Deception users over the previous rolling 90-day period.

quotes: The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of Deception over the previous rolling 90-day period.

risk360.statement: Risk360 is licensed by seats, but the page counts the licenses required as unique ZIA users (not Risk360 users) over the previous rolling 90-day period.

quotes: The number of licenses required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of ZIA over the previous rolling 90-day period.
licensed according to the number of seats purchased for the subscription term in an order.

easm.statement: EASM is licensed by Seat (unique EASM users over the previous rolling 90-day period) or Asset (unique public internet-facing assets: domains, hosts, web pages, SSL/TLS certificates, IP addresses).

quotes: The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique individual users of Zscaler EASM over the previous rolling 90-day period.
Asset: A subscription license for the number of unique public internet-facing corporate assets discovered by EASM

- Domains
  - Hosts
  - Web pages
  - SSL/TLS certificates
  - IP addresses

sspm.statement: SSPM is licensed by Seat (unique users over the previous rolling 90-day period) and Application; the "2 Apps" subscription allows up to two supported SaaS applications with one tenant per application, and seat licensing continues to apply alongside application licenses.

quotes: Seat: A subscription license to the SSPM SaaS for an individual authorized user.
you may onboard and monitor up to two supported SaaS applications, with one tenant per application.
The seat-based licensing requirement continues to apply in conjunction with any application-based licenses.
The number of seats required is determined by counting the total number of unique users accessing or using the SaaS over the previous rolling 90-day period.
If you purchased the "2 Apps" subscription

zsdk.statement: ZSDK is licensed by Monthly Active Users (MAUs) for a client mobile app: an active user logs into the app at least once in a calendar month, and the MAUs required are unique monthly active users counted over the previous rolling 90-day period.

quotes: An active user is defined as an individual authorized user that logs into the client mobile app at least once during a calendar month.
The number of MAUs required is determined by counting the total number of unique monthly active users over the previous rolling 90-day period.

cellular.statement: Zscaler Cellular is licensed by protected cellular devices (Zscaler SIMs purchased, or unique IP addresses accessing Cellular Edge) and data usage; a data pool resets on the first day of each calendar month, unused data is not carried over, and a partial first month is prorated.

quotes: unique IP addresses accessing Zscaler Cellular Edge (for Cellular Edge).
The data pool resets on the first day of each calendar month, and unused data is not carried over.
the data pool and billing for the initial partial month will be prorated based on the number of remaining days in that month.
The number of protected cellular devices is determined by the number of Zscaler SIMs purchased from Zscaler (for Zscaler SIM)

endpoint-ai.statement: Endpoint AI Security is licensed by protected endpoints: host machines where the Endpoint AI Security module is installed and running, whether via Client Connector or a standalone installation.

quotes: A protected endpoint is a host machine on which the Endpoint AI Security module is installed and running, whether deployed through Zscaler Client Connector or as a standalone installation.
licensed according to the number of protected endpoints purchased for the subscription term in an order.

ai-guard.statement: AI Guard is licensed by a platform subscription fee and tokens; a token is generally four characters (UTF-8 code points, excluding white space) and consumption is the total tokens in prompts and responses.

quotes: licensed based on a platform subscription fee and the number of tokens purchased
A token is generally considered to be four characters, using UTF-8 code points, excluding white space.
AI Guard uses the total number of tokens in prompts and responses to calculate license consumption.

ai-scanning.statement: AI Scanning Platform is licensed by a platform fee and Probe Units: a Standard Probe is a single analysis function and a Large Probe is one that exceeds 200 test cases; Probe Units are consumed when you run a Standard Probe, Large Probe or Scanner Run.

quotes: Standard Probe: A single discrete analysis function executed by the AI Scanning Platform on an AI system.
Large Probe: A single discrete analysis function executed by the AI Scanning Platform which exceeds 200 test cases.
Probe Units are consumed when you execute a Standard Probe, Large Probe, or a Scanner Run.
licensed based on a platform subscription fee and the number of Probe Units purchased

ai-infra.statement: AI Asset Management for AI Infrastructure is licensed by AI assets: custom AI applications, AI models, MCP endpoints or AI agents in public cloud environments or SaaS AI builder platforms, counted as unique ones configured as scanned over the subscription period.

quotes: for an individual authorized custom AI application, AI model, Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint, or AI agent

The number of AI assets required is the total number of unique individual custom AI applications, AI models, MCP endpoints, AI agents, and any additional supported service that is configured as a scanned service by you during the subscription period.
that you use in your public cloud environments (e.g. AWS Bedrock) or SaaS AI builder platform (e.g. Microsoft Copilot Studio)

ai-platform.statement: AI Asset Management Platform is licensed by seats for users whose traffic is monitored for AI application usage (generative, embedded and endpoint AI applications); a provisioned ZIA tenant is for AI Asset Management traffic visibility only, with no other ZIA capabilities unless separately licensed.

quotes: A seat is a subscription license for the AI Asset Management Platform service for an individual authorized user whose traffic is monitored for AI application usage.
This ZIA tenant is provided only for AI Asset Management traffic visibility.
You are not entitled to other ZIA capabilities (e.g., general internet traffic monitoring, web filtering, non-AI application traffic inspection, etc.) unless separately licensed under ZIA.

- Generative AI applications
- Embedded AI applications
- Endpoint AI applications

secops.statement: Agentic SOC is licensed by entities, each a unique identity, endpoint or cloud resource, counted as the entities processed and stored in Agentic SOC.

quotes: An entity is defined as a unique identity, endpoint, or cloud resource.
counting the total number of entities processed and stored in Agentic SOC.

aem.statement: AEM is licensed by assets, counted as the assets processed and stored into AEM.

quotes: The number of assets is counted as the number of assets processed and stored into AEM.

uvm.statement: UVM is licensed by assets, counted as the total assets processed and stored in UVM.

quotes: The number of assets is counted as the total number of assets processed and stored in UVM.

idp.statement: Identity Protection is licensed by user identities, counted as those processed and stored in it; a user identity is each unique individual provisioned, managed or represented in the application whether or not they log in.

quotes: The number of user identities is counted as the total number of user identities processed and stored in Identity Protection.
regardless of whether such individual directly accesses or logs into the Identity Protection SaaS application.
For Identity Protection, user identity means each unique individual whose identity is provisioned, managed, or otherwise represented within the Identity Protection SaaS application

netobs.statement: Network Observability is licensed by Device (unique IP addresses configured over the subscription period) and Metrics (monitored metrics, which vary by networking device type).

quotes: The number of devices is determined by counting the total number of unique IP addresses configured for Network Observability over the subscription period.
The number of metrics that can be collected from each device is determined by the type of networking device.

ztbranch.statement: Zero Trust Branch is licensed by the number of appliances enabled for protected devices, counted as installed appliances for each of the protected devices.

quotes: licensed by the number of appliances enabled for protected devices during the subscription term.
determined by counting the number of installed appliances for each of the protected devices

devseg.statement: Zero Trust Device Segmentation (formerly Airgap) is licensed by gateways enabled for protected devices, counted as installed gateways, with additional entitlements allowing more devices per gateway.

quotes: Zscaler Zero Trust Device Segmentation (formerly Airgap) is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product that is licensed by the number of gateways enabled for protected devices during the subscription term.
You may purchase additional entitlements allowing the addition of additional devices to a gateway.
The number of gateways enabled for segmentation is determined by counting the number of installed gateways for each of the protected devices

ztg.statement: Zero Trust Gateway is licensed by Monthly Traffic (GB; includes ZIA and ZPA workload entitlement, with an additional 10 GB of Layer-4 east-west and ingress enforcement for every 1 GB of ZIA and ZPA egress) and Gateway Instance (an instance in an AWS Availability Zone; at least two instances are needed to use a gateway in an AWS region).

quotes: For every 1 GB of ZIA and ZPA egress traffic, you receive an additional 10 GB total for Layer-4 policy enforcement for east-west and ingress traffic flows.
A minimum of two gateway instances is needed to use a gateway in an AWS region.
Each gateway instance license provides entitlement to a Zero Trust Gateway instance in an Availability Zone in any Amazon Web Services (AWS) region.
The monthly traffic is measured in gigabytes (GB) and is subscribed accordingly.
The monthly traffic component also includes entitlement to Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platforms for workloads.

workload-comms.statement: Effective April 19, 2024, the Zscaler Workload Communications licensing and fair use policy was replaced by the ZIA and/or ZPA policies, respectively; the page points to the licensing metrics for Workload under those policies.

quotes: Effective April 19, 2024, Licensing and Fair Use Policy for Zscaler Workload Communications has been replaced
Please refer to the licensing metrics for “Workload” under those policies.
has been replaced by the Licensing and Fair Use Policy for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and/or Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), respectively.

copied-unit-wording.title: Whether the seat, site, workload and monthly traffic review wording on asset-licensed pages is meant
copied-unit-wording.detail: The AEM and UVM licensing pages say Zscaler periodically reviews the number of seats, sites, workloads and amount of monthly traffic although the license unit is assets; the AI Infrastructure page says data stores. No claim is made from that wording, which looks copied from another page.
